arabic: حمٓ
translation: Ha, Meem

arabic: وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
translation: By the Enlightening Scripture

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
translation: We have revealed it on a Blessed Night—We have warned

arabic: فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
translation: In it is distinguished every wise command

arabic: أَمۡرٗا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
translation: A decree from Us. We have been sending messages

arabic: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
translation: As mercy from your Lord. He is the Hearer, the Knower

arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you know for sure

arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
translation: There is no god but He. He gives life and causes death—your Lord and Lord of your ancestors of old

arabic: بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكّٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
translation: Yet they play around in doubt

arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: So watch out for the Day when the sky produces a visible smoke

arabic: يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
translation: Enveloping mankind; this is a painful punishment

arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: “Our Lord, lift the torment from us, we are believers.”

arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
translation: But how can they be reminded? An enlightening messenger has already come to them

arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ
translation: But they turned away from him, and said, “Educated, but crazy!”

arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
translation: We will ease the punishment a little, but you will revert

arabic: يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
translation: The Day when We launch the Great Assault—We will avenge

arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولٞ كَرِيمٌ
translation: Before them We tested the people of Pharaoh; a noble messenger came to them

arabic: أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٞ
translation: Saying, “Hand over God’s servants to me. I am an honest messenger to you.”

arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
translation: And, “Do not exalt yourselves above God. I come to you with clear authority

arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
translation: I have taken refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me

arabic: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
translation: But if you do not believe in me, keep away from me.”

arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمٞ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
translation: He appealed to his Lord: “These are a sinful people.”

arabic: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
translation: “Set out with My servants by night—you will be followed

arabic: وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندٞ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
translation: And cross the sea quickly; they are an army to be drowned.”

arabic: كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
translation: How many gardens and fountains did they leave behind

arabic: وَزُرُوعٖ وَمَقَامٖ كَرِيمٖ
translation: And plantations, and splendid buildings

arabic: وَنَعۡمَةٖ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
translation: And comforts they used to enjoy

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
translation: So it was; and We passed it on to another people

arabic: فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
translation: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor were they reprieved

arabic: وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
translation: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating persecution

arabic: مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
translation: From Pharaoh. He was a transgressing tyrant

arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
translation: And We chose them knowingly over all other people

arabic: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٞاْ مُّبِينٌ
translation: And We gave them many signs, in which was an obvious test

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
translation: These people say

arabic: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
translation: “There is nothing but our first death, and we will not be resurrected

arabic: فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful.”

arabic: أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعٖ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
translation: Are they better, or the people of Tubba and those before them? We annihilated them. They were evildoers

arabic: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them to play

arabic: مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: We created them only for a specific purpose, but most of them do not know

arabic: إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
translation: The Day of Sorting Out is the appointed time for them all

arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
translation: The Day when no friend will avail a friend in any way, and they will not be helped

arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: Except for him upon whom God has mercy. He is the Mighty, the Merciful

arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
translation: The Tree of Bitterness

arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
translation: The food of the sinner

arabic: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
translation: Like molten lead; boiling inside the bellies

arabic: كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
translation: Like the boiling of seething water

arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
translation: Seize him and drag him into the midst of Hell

arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
translation: Then pour over his head the suffering of the Inferno

arabic: ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
translation: Taste! You who were powerful and noble

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
translation: This is what you used to doubt

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٖ
translation: As for the righteous, they will be in a secure place

arabic: فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
translation: Amidst gardens and springs

arabic: يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٖ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقٖ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
translation: Dressed in silk and brocade, facing one another

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
translation: So it is, and We will wed them to lovely companions

arabic: يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, in peace and security

arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
translation: Therein they will not taste death, beyond the first death; and He will protect them from the torment of Hell

arabic: فَضۡلٗا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
translation: A favor from your Lord. That is the supreme salvation

arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
translation: We made it easy in your language, so that they may remember

arabic: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
translation: So wait and watch. They too are waiting and watching
